question: Who has been named as the new chief minister of Tripura in May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Manik Saha.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Manik Saha took oath as Tripura's new Chief Minister on 15th May 2022.
 
• Saha has replaced Biplab Kumar Deb, who resigned as chief minister on 14th May.
 
• Dr. Saha, a professor of Dental Surgery, joined the BJP in 2016.
 
• Rajya Sabha MP and BJP State President Manik Saha is all set to take charge as the new Chief Minister of Tripura__.
 
• Manik Saha, BJP's state unit president, and the lone Rajya Sabha MP from Tripura were elected as the leader of the legislature party at a meeting held at the official residence of the chief minister.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information:__**

 
• ​Tripura is a hilly state in northeast India, bordered on 3 sides by Bangladesh, and home to a diverse mix of tribal cultures and religious groups.

​Tripura:

 
• Union territory: 1 November 1956
 
• Upgraded as a state: 21 January 1972
 
• Tripura Governor: Satyadev Narayan Arya
 
• Tripura capital: Agartala
 
• Legislature: Unicameral (60 seats)
 
• According to Article 164 of the Indian Constitution, the Chief Minister is appointed by the Governor.
 
 
• Art. 164 of the Constitution provides that there shall be a Council of Ministers with the Chief Minister to aid and advise the Governor.
